name: digita-plugins-free
description: Digita FREE plugins — a pnpm workspace of flat per-plugin @digitaplatform/<id> packages (component | design | signature, tier: free). Bundled with the platform and published to GitHub Packages alongside the paid digita-plugins-store. Goes public/OSS later. Holds: usermenu (component), minimal (design), digita, simetrix and the three looks of the demo company Veloluck (signatures).
